programme.title: 林則徐 虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: 2025年，適逢民族英雄林則徐誕辰二百四十周年國家主席習近平在福州任職期間，保育了林則徐出生地的一系列遺跡他先後多次引用林則徐苟利國家生死以，豈因禍福避趨之的名句，號召國人把林則徐的民族精神和優秀品格繼承發揚下去ampampampampltbrampampampampgt林則徐：虎門銷煙以外是一部由香港電台出品的五集歷史人文紀錄片影片以香港視角出發，跨越三萬公里深入中國多省市（包括澳門廣東湖南福建浙江河南陝西甘肅新疆），更東渡日本，探尋虎門銷煙之外那個更為真實立體的林則徐ampampampampltbrampampampampgt林則徐虎門銷煙的壯舉固然永載史冊，但其光輝遠不止於此本紀錄片突破傳統敘事框架，不僅回顧林則徐虎門銷煙的功績，更深入挖掘他作為治水能臣嚴謹學者流放者與思想家的多面人生透過實地探訪專家訪談，並結合AI技術生成動畫重現歷史場景，影片呈現林則徐在禁煙海防水利邊疆開發等方面的卓越貢獻，並揭示其開眼看世界的深遠影響節目以細膩的鏡頭語言和情感敘述，串聯歷史與當下，展現林則徐精神的當代意義，值此民族英雄誕辰二百四十周年之際，向他獻上最誠摯的敬意本片由ampampampamplt香港電台ampampampampgt贈播

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 헌트

programme.title: 명탐정 코난 극장판:시한장치의 마천루
programme.desc: 1997년 4월 19일에 공개되어, 극장판 lt명탐정 코난gt 시리즈의 기념할만한 제 1작품이다. 첫 시리즈로 흥행수입 11억엔 이라는 성공을 거두어, 현재 코난 극장판은 12작품을 넘어서고 있다. 그리고 첫번째 극장판이 만들어질 당시만 해도 원작이 약간 어린이용으로 의식되었던 시기라 부분 부분 그 후의 작품에서는 볼 수 없게 된 개그나 엉망진창 캐릭터 등을 볼 수 있다.

programme.title: 명탐정 코난 극장판2:14번째 표적
programme.desc: 1998년 4월 18일에 공개 되었던 극장판 명탐정 코난 시리즈 제 2작품이다. 흥행수입은 18억5000만엔 배급수입은 10억 4000만엔을 올렸다. 상영시간은 99분. 메인캐릭터가 범인에게 차례로 습격을 당한다는 대담한 스토리 전개를 보인다. 이 대담한 컨셉은 나중에 눈동자 속의 암살자에서 이어가고 있다.

programme.title: 프레데터스

programme.title: 대한민국을 바꾼 법의 탄생 : 헌법을 말하다
광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 동시방영작여성향 게임 세계는 모브에게 가혹한 세계입니다2
아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 歲月風雲之上海皇帝
programme.desc: 陸月生本是小販出身，因用流氓手法偵破宋教仁被刺案而聲名大噪，受到法租界總探長黃全榮賞識，從此平步青雲，依附軍閥勢力，逐步攀升成為上海大亨但好景不長，1927年，上海迎來前所未有的社會動盪與政治鉅變，軍閥割據，民不聊生，國共反目，工人造反，陸月生最終被國民黨利用，參與了反對鎮壓工人武裝的鬥爭與屠殺共產黨人的陰謀

programme.title: 警察故事III超級警察
programme.desc: 陳家駒遠赴大陸臥底打入國際軍火毒品走私集團內部，在美女公安楊建華的幫助下，順利接近了正在服刑的集團成員豹強，密謀越獄成功建華自稱家駒妹妹同行，來到香港加入販毒集團，集團老大猜霸帶領手下赴吉隆坡營救被綁架的妻子，不料家駒與建華之臥底身份被揭發，被迫與集團展開連番惡鬥

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒
programme.desc: 滿清年間，旗人子弟蘇察哈爾燦目不識丁揮霍成性為贏得丐幫美女如霜芳心，決定上京考武狀元蘇父買通考官由師爺代筆考中武狀元，但被臥底宮中之天理教教主趙無忌揭發舞弊皇帝怒將燦父子貶為乞丐流落街頭，燦又遭趙無忌打成殘廢後燦偶遇丐幫長老洪日慶授以睡夢羅漢拳，如霜被趙無忌擄走，燦以睡夢羅漢拳奪得幫主之位，率眾迎戰造反之趙無忌，終於領悟降龍十八掌

programme.title: 急凍行者上
programme.desc: 錦衣衛高手賀英奉皇帝之命前往天竺國曾歃血為盟的兄弟元龍聶虎和薩獒，在賀英歸來途中對他展開突襲，而一陣地動山搖引來巨大雪崩，將四人一併淹沒400年後，被意外解凍的賀英來到了現代社會，但聶虎薩獒元龍三人也相繼從冰封中解凍，他們為了各自的目的不停追捕賀英，四兄弟之間的秘密也相繼揭開

programme.title: 六扇門 7-9 首
programme.desc: 六扇門 7-9 首

programme.title: 急凍行者下
programme.desc: 明朝將軍賀英阿狗與聶虎來到現在香港，經歷青馬大橋之戰，最終阿狗死去，而賀英與阿虎則被警方扣查從明朝來到現代的副警務署張一鳴帶走賀英與阿狗，藉賀英手上的時空金碟回到明朝，而賀英選擇回到桃源村的道路，卻影響了他與其他相關人等的往後命運

programme.title: 談判專家首
programme.desc: 談判專家卓文偉意外成為一樁命案的頭號嫌犯，被逼無奈下他占領警署挾持員警作人質，並指定前談判專家謝家俊與自己對話，擅長攻心的謝家俊與技巧高超的卓文偉反復拉鋸，唇槍舌戰間，兩人的立場與心態逐漸發生改變

programme.title: 黑俠
programme.desc: 徐夕隸屬專門訓練無痛無感殺手的組織：701部隊，但他不欲成為殺人工具，故隱身香港，從事圖書館文員來掩飾身份徐夕不懂人際，常遭同事白眼，唯獨有兩個人接近他，一個是圖書館女同事Tracy，另一個是棋友辣手神探石Sir當701部隊突然出現，徐夕為友情化身成為黑俠，出手與701部隊對抗

programme.title: 非常警探
programme.desc: 重案組警探高建守意外撞死一名男子，手足無措的他絞盡腦汁，將藏屍的念頭動在剛過世的母親棺材裡，並開始一連串脫罪計畫正當他自以為渡過風險之時，一名自稱是目擊者的人不斷打來威脅他，並逼問屍體的下落，高警探渾然不知自己正捲進一宗更驚人詭譎的案件中

programme.title: 倩女幽魂2：人間道
programme.desc: 甯采臣與好友燕赤霞分手後，路過市集無故被陷入獄，幸得通天博士諸葛臥龍相助逃獄成功，更與鬼馬道宜知秋因誤會以致相交，並投宿一荒廢山莊山莊內盡是忠義之士，在傅清風與妹傅月池的帶領下，準備營救被陷入獄的父親傅天仇甯覺清風貌似舊愛小倩，以為是小倩投胎，遂留下試探大將軍左千戶正押解傅天仇至山莊附近，提議眾人求助於護法國丈，豈料法丈實為妖精化身，甯與清風至蘭若寺尋得燕赤霞相助，正邪大戰隨之展開

programme.title: 上海皇帝之雄霸天下
programme.desc: 1930年代，陸月生黃全榮及袁嘯軍合稱上海三大亨此時的上海一步步成為國共兩黨內部的戰場，加上日軍野心勃勃，社會瀰漫著軍變前的恐慌陸月生感到前途茫茫，希望藉國民黨的力量在政治上找尋出頭機會然而在狡詐的政治舞台，其背景反成為被攻擊的把柄，一代梟雄失意後一病不起含恨而終

programme.title: 血滴子
programme.desc: 雍正王朝為打壓反清復明勢力，創立特種暗殺部隊血滴子此部隊從小接受專業訓練，擅長操作神祕暗器血滴子，此飛天武器威力驚人，發射直搗目標人頭，因殺人於無形，從未有人見其真實樣貌乾隆年間，反清復明組織牧人信眾萬人日漸強大，首領天狼更是武功高強，嚴重威脅朝廷血滴子隊長冷奉命率領部隊剷除異己，卻不知身陷更大的陰謀之中

programme.title: 風再起時
programme.desc: 70年代，香港廉政公署成立，對貪污探長進行追捕，揭開殖民地時代落幕前的篇章曾因不收賄而飽受壓迫的員警磊樂與南江，想要改變現狀，攜手建立員警貪污制度，並坐上總華探長位置然而，權力膨脹導致黑白勢力失衡，同時香港廉政公署成立，調查主任李子超對貪污探長展開全球通緝，磊樂與南江隻手遮天的年代走向謝幕風再起時，香港已不同往昔

programme.title: 與龍共舞
programme.desc: 富家公子龍家俊（劉德華飾）意外落海，在香港離島大嶼山遇上公司員工月光（張敏飾）與其母月十一（葉德嫻飾），遂佯稱偷渡客大陸雞藏身於月光家工作，同時其表兄馬丁鞏（張堅庭飾）則趁機串通外人欲奪龍氏企業產權最終龍家俊真實身分曝光，他該如何解決家族鬥爭，並贏回月光姑娘的芳心？

programme.title: 六扇門 10-12 首
programme.desc: 六扇門 10-12 首

programme.title: 青面修羅
programme.desc: 因一塊藏寶銅片慘遭滅門的青面修羅齊君元，在神秘刺客組織離恨谷長大某日離恨谷受託奪取藏寶銅片，谷主卻未派齊君元追查，但齊君元決意復仇，不惜叛谷暗自出馬調查血案消失多年的銅片為何再現？面對各路高手追殺捲入兩國鬥爭，齊君元發現自己已身陷局中，設局者是何方神聖？神秘委託人又是何許人也？

programme.title: 九龍城寨之圍城
programme.desc: 落難青年陳洛軍因得罪大老闆而被追殺，為了避禍誤闖九龍城寨，在城寨內結識了信一十二少四仔等人，成為換帖好兄弟眾兄弟們以城寨精神領袖龍捲風馬首是瞻，奮力抵抗惡霸大老闆的入侵，展開連番惡鬥，勢死保衛城寨這個安身之地

programme.title: 戰狼部隊1：同袍回歸
programme.desc: 戰狼部隊隸屬於警察特種部隊無線電偵查小組，是小組中最傑出強悍的一支部隊此次任務是前往一處遭恐怖份子劫持的學區，解救被迫成為人質的市長與學生們

programme.title: 戰狼部隊2：危險行動
programme.desc: 喬與波聯手欲逮捕在馬爾丁郊外的恐怖份子巴赫茲，參與這場武裝護衛行動的每位成員都將承受恐怖威脅的挑戰戰狼部隊此番行動將面臨滂沱大雨以及潛伏於內部的陰謀，同時必須成功移送未知的恐怖份子

programme.title: 戰狼部隊3：千鈞一髮
programme.desc: 戰狼部隊因檢察公署的行政考量，遭強制重組成兩支小隊，一隊負責與特種部隊和喬聯合打擊內部叛徒，另一隊則留在伊斯坦堡恐怖份子包圍了圖然與卡雅，雅伊木蘭特必須在有限的援助下，設法前往阿巴斯泰佩救出他的部隊

programme.title: 反恐行動：獨立日
programme.desc: 12月6日是芬蘭的國慶日：獨立日，但今年顯得特別不平靜，總統官邸遭到恐怖份子襲擊，連總統在內的大批貴賓遭挾持成為人質！安全情報局幹員麥克斯被指派為這場人質危機的談判專家，他必須採取大膽行動，找出幕後真凶不僅人命關天，甚至整個歐洲的未來安危都肩負在麥克斯身上！

programme.title: 下一站，托斯卡尼
programme.desc: 一位畫家，帶著他關係疏遠的兒子，兩人從倫敦返回義大利，想出售已故妻子多年前一起生活過的房子不過這棟房子年久失修，客廳牆壁還有一大片難以理解的彩繪，導致完全沒人想買下這棟房子兩人只好試圖與當地居民，一同運用手邊僅有的工具，開始修繕這棟老舊房屋同時，這對父子也沒想到，當他們放下繁忙生活，來到義大利托斯卡尼鄉間，似乎也開始找到屬於他們的未來

programme.title: 美聲歌雞
programme.desc: 圖魯是一隻相貌古怪且不會下蛋的母雞，因此遭到其他母雞的嘲笑和排擠曾是音樂老師的老奶奶伊莎貝爾非常喜歡圖魯，她將圖魯帶到自己的農場，竟意外發現圖魯的獨特天賦她不僅能夠跟人類說話，還有著美麗的動人歌聲，但伊莎貝爾害怕其他人會利用圖魯的天賦賺錢，於是決定守住這個秘密某天，伊莎貝爾從屋頂上摔下來而且失去了記憶，隨後被救護車送往醫院；想念老奶奶的圖魯決定踏上旅程尋找她珍貴的好友！

programme.title: 雷霆殺陣
programme.desc: 米榭爾維隆是個賽車天才，儘管家人持反對意見，米榭爾始終追求自己的理想，那就是一定要取得利曼24小時耐力賽冠軍憑藉著熱情與堅強體魄，以及冷靜的分析判斷能力，米榭爾終於拿到了這項比賽的冠軍一時媒體和車迷都奉他為世界賽車的未來天皇巨星就在各種鮮花喜悅包圍著米榭爾的同時，一場跨國的獵殺行動也悄悄展開

programme.title: 疾凍救援
programme.desc: 在加拿大北部一處偏僻的鑽石礦坑發生重大坍塌意外，一群礦工被埋在坑道內，僅剩30小時的氧氣可以存活一支緊急救難隊靠著巨型卡車橫越300英哩結冰湖面構成冰路，救出被困住的26名礦工但他們真正的威脅卻是過去從未遇過的恐怖危機，原來礦坑企業公司為了隱藏爆炸意外主因被揭發，竟雇用大批殺手阻撓救難隊員行進，一場驚天動地的救難行動在冰天雪地中就此展開！

programme.title: 這個殺手必須死
programme.desc: 不一樣的阿諾史瓦辛格化身百變殺手，完美變裝零瑕疵！為了奪得地表最強殺手稱號，一群剛嶄露頭角的殺手決定聯手幹掉有殺手界不敗神話之稱的甘瑟（阿諾史瓦辛格飾演），但所有計畫彷彿早已被甘瑟識破般，眾殺手不僅兵敗如山倒還被玩弄於股掌間！

programme.title: 絕對逆襲新
programme.desc: 麥克是懷有滿腔熱血與理想的年輕律師，但西裝筆挺的他私底下卻是個重度癮君子某天發生了一起醫護人員因公意外感染愛滋的案件，因為背後隱藏著政府司法及醫療體制構成的龐大秘辛，竟沒有任何一位律師願意為他們發聲為了正義，麥克毅然決然地挺身而出，遊走於黑暗與光明間的他，也被迫面對自己心中的黑洞

programme.title: 疾速殺機
programme.desc: 他是掌管地下非法交易的洛城幕後老大，卻發現遭到最信任的助手蘿娜背叛，怒不可遏之下綁架了她的兒子，交易條件是要她參與一項暗殺敵人的任務

programme.title: 許怨房
programme.desc: 麥特與凱特是一對恩愛夫妻，麥特厭倦了喧囂都市生活，凱特曾兩度懷孕都宣告失敗試圖重新出發的兩人，決定搬入一棟位在紐約郊區的幽靜房子某天，麥特發現一間隱藏在壁紙背後的密室，只要在那間密室中許願都會實現起初，兩人就像孩子踏入糖果屋般興奮，然而凱特愈來愈無法滿足於這些物質上的慾望，而開始想要一個她們夢寐以求的孩子但兩人並不知道，這間密室創造出來的事物，一旦離開這棟房子之後，就將化為灰燼

programme.title: 好萊塢幕後解密新
programme.desc: 好萊塢幕後解密新

programme.title: 爆裂戰警
programme.desc: 十九歲穆斯林少年班哈西遭到警察拘留後失蹤多日，而當特警隊員詹斯與麥可在穆斯林社區巡邏時，意外得知班哈西在醫院傷重不治的消息從新聞媒體傳來，同時點燃起社區穆斯林年輕人及黑幫壓抑已久的怒火，他們將目標對準這對特警以求報復，情況一觸即發頓時失控這兩名警員驚覺自己成了攻擊目標，在重兵埋伏面臨敵眾我寡，種種不利情況下，他們必須搏命奮戰，拼死求生，卻也度過人生最長的一日

programme.title: 戰狼部隊4：秘密任務
programme.desc: 雅伊木蘭特犧牲的六個月後，陰鬱的氣氛逐漸壟罩整個部隊因為一則關於PKK首領令人出乎意料的情報，卡謬和圖然決定暗中以他們的秘密血盒阻止更多情報洩漏

programme.title: 戰狼部隊5：戰略機密
programme.desc: 卡謬因一項秘密任務與隊員之間劍拔奴張，傳奇指揮官奧斯曼艾倫則掌握解決此一秘密任務的關鍵資訊然而來自各方的壓力阻止了戰狼部隊的每一步行動，來自境外勢力的一場軍備攻擊行動將瓦解所有計畫

programme.title: 戰狼部隊6：誓死如歸
programme.desc: 一座位於伊斯坦堡馬斯拉克商務區的摩天大樓，即將遭受大規模的血腥攻擊行動，意外來到現場的卡亞，必須第一時間阻止悲劇的發生，支撐卡亞保護平民免於災禍的動力來自於為妹妹復仇的堅持同一時間，其他行動也在這個國家悄然展開，國家的未來將何去何從？

programme.title: 冰血殺機
programme.desc: 美國鑽石商人盧卡斯前往俄羅斯進行交易卻因故告吹，搭檔也人間蒸發盧卡斯與西伯利亞咖啡館的女店長卡提雅萌生情愫，在危機四伏的鑽石交易市場裡，兩人要如何安然逃離凶險的西伯利亞？

programme.title: 笑笑羊大電影：外星人來了
programme.desc: 一道強光照亮了平靜小鎮，擁有不可思議力量的外星人魯拉，穿越了遙遠的銀河系，迫降在笑笑羊的農場笑笑羊尚恩決定在邪惡組織抓走魯拉之前，將這位可愛的外星朋友，平安送回她的家鄉一場溫馨刺激又笑料百出的宇宙級冒險就此展開！

programme.title: 露西亞的願望：搶救聖誕節
programme.desc: 露西亞是第一個就讀聖誕學院聖誕老人班的女孩她最好的朋友被指控偷了冬季國王的魔法水晶，露西亞決心與奧斯卡一起逃亡，並找到真正的小偷，來證明他的清白

programme.title: 逃出封鎖線
programme.desc: 二戰期間，一支德國坦克軍隊正在向莫斯科前進兩架戰機奉命前往阻止德軍進犯，空軍隊長尼古拉康姆列夫被迫降落在敵軍領地，歷經千辛萬苦後成功返回祖國，但也因傷送醫性命垂危他究竟是否能甦醒展開全新生活，迎接等待他的國家與戀人呢？

programme.title: 星光首映場絕對逆襲
programme.desc: 麥克是懷有滿腔熱血與理想的年輕律師，但西裝筆挺的他私底下卻是個重度癮君子某天發生了一起醫護人員因公意外感染愛滋的案件，因為背後隱藏著政府司法及醫療體制構成的龐大秘辛，竟沒有任何一位律師願意為他們發聲為了正義，麥克毅然決然地挺身而出，遊走於黑暗與光明間的他，也被迫面對自己心中的黑洞

programme.title: 廟街十二少
programme.desc: 他沒有姓名，人們都稱他十二少，因為他有十二個叱吒黑白兩道的乾爹乾媽，表面上他是天之驕子，但他的內心比誰都寂寞某天，十二少遇見一個改變他一生的女人霍德蘭，他們是兩個極端世界的人，但一段真摯浪漫的愛情偏偏在他們之間發生

programme.title: 黃昏三鏢客
programme.desc: 好人壞人小人，三名主角在美國南北戰爭時期，為了南方政府埋藏的一批黃金，展開爾虞我詐勾心鬥角的驚天對決

programme.title: 赤腳小子
programme.desc: 赤腳青年關豐曜進城投靠父親好友，卻意外捲入地方勢力爭鬥，最終為求出人頭地而付出慘痛代價與惡霸決一死戰

programme.title: 古董局中局
programme.desc: 來自日本的木戶加奈小姐即將歸還中國一尊唐代武則天時期的明堂佛頭，指明要文物界組織五脈旗下白字門許家後人出面接收有著一身鑒古天賦的許家後人許願，在黃煙煙勸說下，他不情願的前往交涉，卻敏銳地察覺到佛頭是贗品許願本想逃避，然而面對重重迷霧和威脅，已是身不由己他必須要在各方勢力的糾纏之下，查明真相

programme.title: 飛行世紀
programme.desc: 二十世紀初萊特兄弟成功實現了人類飛行的夢想，英國每日郵報主編羅恩斯利為了彰顯大不列顛帝國的種族優越，便策劃了一場從倫敦飛往巴黎的飛行競賽，但他其實私下盤算讓準女婿梅斯贏得比賽來自世界各地的飛行愛好者帶著自己的愛機湧入倫敦參加比賽，此時邪惡的波西先生和助手卻開始進行破壞和作弊計畫這場冒險者的比賽，意外發展成了一場爭奪羅恩斯利女兒帕崔夏的愛情大賽！

programme.title: 赤腳小子
programme.desc: 赤腳青年關豐曜進城投靠父親好友，卻意外捲入地方勢力爭鬥，最終為求出人頭地而付出慘痛代價與惡霸決一死戰

programme.title: 吊人索
programme.desc: 退休警官杰德庫柏來到西部購買一批牲口準備務農，卻被一群以退役上尉威爾遜為首自稱為民除害的槍手，指控其謀殺及偷竊牛隻，而私下對他處以絞刑庫柏瀕死之際被經過的法警救下，而真實的犯案者也在事後被逮，法官除還庫柏清白外，更力邀庫柏重回警職擔任警長，成為美國西部聯邦法警庫柏決心整治濫用私刑問題為嫌犯爭取公平審判，並將那班原欲吊死他的惡徒一一繩之以法

programme.title: 哮天神犬勇闖龍宮
programme.desc: 哮天犬因救龍王，三太子有功，得到龍王贈予龍珠，化為人形的哮天犬生性善良，誤中貓妖的詭計被其逃出天牢玉帝震怒，問責哮天犬的同時將其貶入人間

programme.title: 怪獸總進擊
programme.desc: 西元1999年，人類以高科技將地球十大怪獸集中在小笠原群島上，與人類和平共處某日黃色氣體籠罩全島，怪獸與控制中心的人類均不省人事不久後哥吉拉拉頓摩斯拉哥羅恐龍等怪獸在世界各國失控冒出大肆破壞！月光SY-3太空船被緊急派往月球探查，發現外星人弱點後化解危機；然而宇宙怪獸王者基多拉再次降臨，怪獸軍團們能否成功守護地球？

programme.title: 紅色密令
programme.desc: 瓊安是個在郊區安享退休生活的平凡老婦人某天，英國特勤局突然上門，並指控她在二戰期間擔任女間諜，甚至透露原子彈機密給敵國俄羅斯在偵訊過程當中，瓊安回憶起1930年代的劍橋大學生涯，她與一位俄羅斯同學里歐交往，因而接觸共產理念畢業後她加入實驗室研發核彈機密計畫，卻因見到原子彈造成的大規模毀滅而備感愧疚她究竟該選擇背叛良心，還是背叛國家？

programme.title: 大洪荒
programme.desc: 公元前百萬年的遠古時代，高原洞穴中的岩石部落，首領阿可荷巴的次子托馬克因不服父親搶奪自己的食物而遭驅逐，流浪至海邊被較文明的貝殼族所救他因奮勇擊退巨獸而為貝殼族所擁戴，並受該族美女羅安納仰慕，而後率領貝殼族人歷經千辛萬苦回到岩石部落，卻人事已非其兄長沙卡納謀害父親並繼任成為新的首領，而高原上的火山也即將爆發

programme.title: 青面修羅
programme.desc: 因一塊藏寶銅片慘遭滅門的青面修羅齊君元，在神秘刺客組織離恨谷長大某日離恨谷受託奪取藏寶銅片，谷主卻未派齊君元追查，但齊君元決意復仇，不惜叛谷暗自出馬調查血案消失多年的銅片為何再現？面對各路高手追殺捲入兩國鬥爭，齊君元發現自己已身陷局中，設局者是何方神聖？神秘委託人又是何許人也？

programme.title: 越南大戰
programme.desc: 美國綠扁帽特種部隊麥克科比上校被調派至南越政府軍的聯合前線基地輪替指揮官一職，但北越軍方亦試圖要奪取這尚未建構完善的戰略要地，雙方持續處於血腥的拉鋸戰，悲慘的卻是夾縫中的百姓上校除奮勇率隊作戰，更協助醫護安置百姓，秘密行動即將展開，任務是深入敵後擄走掌控整個越共軍力的北越將軍

programme.title: 非誠勿擾2
programme.desc: 秦奮決心與笑笑白頭到老，笑笑對秦奮的感情卻止於好感，在秦奮好友的離婚典禮啟發下，兩人決定先從試婚開始然而秦奮深沉的愛意卻對笑笑帶來無形的壓力，兩人只能分道揚鑣距離遠了，感情好像也就淡了，在兩人似乎已忘記對方的同時，他們生活的軌跡又再次交錯，在好友點化下，笑笑似乎明白了婚姻的真諦

programme.title: 浩劫餘生：人猿星球
programme.desc: 二十世紀美國太空船在離開地球六個月後，墜落在類似地球環境的無名行星船長泰勒和倖存隊員，發現星球上存在沒有語言能力的原始人類，並被一群具有智慧的人猿獵捕原來這星球是由人猿所統治，人類如動物般被豢養獵殺解剖研究所幸泰勒遇到同情人類的心理學家齊拉博士，在其與考古學家男友康尼利博士協助下展開逃亡，前往人猿聖書中所記載的荒原禁區

programme.title: 危城
programme.desc: 民國初年，時值中國內戰軍閥割據亂世時代，一個叫普城的偏遠城鎮，其治安由普城保衛團暫管由於軍閥少帥曹少璘（古天樂飾）殺害三條人命，普城保衛團團長楊克難（劉青雲飾）於是將曹少帥繩之於法，然曹軍財雄勢大，以強權震懾居民，曹軍上校張亦（吳京飾）得悉事件後，趕來普城取人，遇上多年不見之浪人師弟馬鋒（彭于晏飾）馬鋒路見不平欲拔刀相助，卻面臨正義與兄弟情之抉擇

programme.title: 戰略大作戰
programme.desc: 二戰盟軍在法國南部遭遇德軍頑強抵抗，美軍偵察前鋒部隊擄獲一名德軍情報局上校為長官背黑鍋而被拔除中尉官階的士兵凱利，灌醉上校後套出德軍藏匿大筆金條要後送柏林，於是開始招兵買馬說服隊上弟兄長官，準備利用即將到來的三天假期，進行一場神不知鬼不覺的敵後奪寶大作戰！

programme.title: 整形過後--慾望與認同
programme.desc: 台灣首部整形醫療影集整形過後，整的不只是臉，而是心！！華麗卻殘酷的醫美產業，揭開變美的創傷與代價技術頂尖卻內心破碎的整形外科醫師江浩宇，遇上正直倔強從公立醫院轉來的楊雅頌，被迫直視醫療倫理與八年前未解的傷痛兩人與診所執行長蘇菲，交織出情感與權力的拉扯一樁樁醫美案例浮上檯面，被控制的女星術後猝死的公關非法醫療與重建自我的病人，不斷拷問真正的治療是什麼這是一段關於修復放下與重生的故事

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 2023紅星大獎獲最佳電視劇 自閉症家庭的家人間扶持溫馨勵志小品鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 整形過後--慾望與認同
programme.desc: 台灣首部整形醫療影集整形過後，整的不只是臉，而是心！！華麗卻殘酷的醫美產業，揭開變美的創傷與代價技術頂尖卻內心破碎的整形外科醫師江浩宇，遇上正直倔強從公立醫院轉來的楊雅頌，被迫直視醫療倫理與八年前未解的傷痛兩人與診所執行長蘇菲，交織出情感與權力的拉扯一樁樁醫美案例浮上檯面，被控制的女星術後猝死的公關非法醫療與重建自我的病人，不斷拷問真正的治療是什麼這是一段關於修復放下與重生的故事

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 2023紅星大獎獲最佳電視劇 自閉症家庭的家人間扶持溫馨勵志小品鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 歐若拉公主

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款! 尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛? 講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中夏娃的醜聞裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天邪門徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.desc: 完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款! 尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛? 講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中夏娃的醜聞裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天邪門徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數

programme.title: 穹蒼下的世界英
programme.desc: 南非西部位於非洲大陸南端，有優美的海灘巍峨的山嶺和怡人的遠足徑西岸一帶有鑽石礦，南岸則可觀賞鯨魚羅本島上有座監獄，因為一位政治犯而聞名全球，現在更獲列為世界遺產地

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英
programme.desc: 在懷舊週的淘汰賽，廚神廚房搖身一變，成為1970年代的客廳挑戰分為兩回合，在第一回合，參賽者輪流試食和辨認芝士種類，頭五個猜錯的要落入第二回合，在75分鐘內，以經典的澳洲菜為靈感，做出美食

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英
programme.desc: 在淘汰賽的第二回合，瑪麗莎華夫莉安娜洛比和露要在十道懷舊菜式中選一道為靈感，炮製美食但有兩位參賽者因意外原因，在最後一刻改變主意他們會因這決定得救，還是出局？最後誰能留下，誰要離開？

programme.title: 狗狗老友記英
programme.desc: 一隻山羊與守護犬和牠的小狗建立起友誼，牠們純純的愛發展為忠誠可靠的關係兩隻四爪陸龜和一隻狗一見如故一隻三色母貓照顧病羊，讓牠回復健康，一貓一羊親密無間流落街頭的受傷烏鴉因兩隻狗而回復健康

programme.title: 澳洲滋味精選英

programme.title: 節拍小天地英

programme.title: 明珠絕色:野性中國英

programme.title: 優遊假期英

programme.title: Abandoned
programme.desc: DNA detectives track down the British soldiers who fathered children in Kenya then disappeared, leaving the children and their mothers without support. Its?a quest to find a missing part of the childrens identities. With access to every stage of this?cutting-edge?process, we follow as a team of lawyers and a leading geneticist travel to Kenya to help?locate?the British soldiers who fathered children then vanished. We?witness?the groundbreaking legal and scientific detective work used to find the missing dads. Lawyers believe British soldiers stationed at the army base in Nanyuki, Kenya, may have fathered hundreds of children over decades - the oldest we meet is now 70, the youngest just 18 months old. Whats?at stake is more than the reputation of the British army and the UKs post-colonial legacy. The mixed-heritage children have in some cases been ostracised by their communities and denied a chance of British citizenship since birth - something which could transform their lives.

But on arrival, these Grandparents seem more of a lively bunch than Duggee was expecting! Tags Gran parachutes in from a plane and Norries Gran is a biker and arrives on her motorbike! Once in the clubhouse they launch into Show Tell. These Grandparents have some GREAT stories to share!

The squirrels decide it is time to tidy up. Luckily Duggee has his Organising Badge, and with the help of the Squirrels they reorganize everything in the clubhouse. Once finished they head outside... but how best to organise the animals?

The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

To make matters worse, Glitch and his Grimbots lose control of the vacuum, causing chaos in the ocean. Can the Go Jetters protect the crabs while also returning the sand to its proper place?

Can the Go Jetters fix their own glitch and save the festival?

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hons pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy fathers dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Mans best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his familys massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting Alfred Chang who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bos magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Openthe Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Mans matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

But when an overtired Nicholas keeps her awake, the Dews must help keep Nicholas quiet, even if it takes all night.

programme.title: Sea Monsters Puff Fruit
programme.desc: Rumors of scary sea monsters in the East End take the kids on a journey of discovering you shouldnt believe everything you hear. Mysterious globs disturbing the ocean turn out to be the byproduct of food from Unicorn Land.

programme.title: Chef Js Tale
programme.desc: Chef J tells a tale about unicorns sailing in ships on clouds in search of Unicorn Land.

programme.title: Heather Report Part II
programme.desc: Hiccup and the gang infiltrate the outsiders in order to free Heathers parents.

programme.title: Thawfest

programme.desc: Hiccup and the gang struggle to uphold the traditions that keep the peace between Berk and the Beserkers.

programme.title: When Lightning Strikes

programme.title: What Flies Beneath
programme.desc: Toothless encounters a rival from his past.

programme.title: Alex And Behemoth
programme.desc: When Alex realizes hes too small to climb onto his new habitat stage, he feels too small for his dreams- until he hears of a big, new roller coaster at Coney Island and figures if he can ride the big coaster, thatll prove that hes a BIG deal! But when Alex is too short to be allowed on the ride- and his friends find themselves stuck at the top of it- Alex saves the day when he realizes that there are advantages to being small, and learns that his body is perfect just the way it is.

programme.title: Model Behavior Pillow Fight Club
programme.desc: Satin and Chenille put on a fashion show to impress the trendsetter of Troll VillagePoppy and Branch start a massive villagewide pillow battle to determine who gets the pillow of destiny.

programme.title: The Imposter Frenemy

programme.title: An Uphill Battle

Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: The Mad Scientist
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blades brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 1

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk Season 1
programme.desc: Live through a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. See how the sun affects the movement, feeding habits, and mating rituals of everything from tiny zooplankton to whale sharks.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk Season 1
programme.desc: Celebrate the first day of spring with Aussie creatures looking for either a dinner or a date. From the kangaroos in the grasslands to the koalas in the trees to the freshwater crocodiles, they hunt for food or fight for breeding rights.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk Season 1
programme.desc: Meet the unique primates and reptiles searching for water and dodging predators, from ring-tailed lemurs in the east coast rainforests to tiny brown leaf chameleons, in this land of extreme climate variations and habitats.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk Season 1
programme.desc: Visit one of the most arid and hottest parts of the world to discover how dhub lizards and dromedary camels adapted to withstand the intense conditions. Then move into the more moderate southern mountains, where rare hyrax and chameleons forage.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snares indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to sur...

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Evolution Earth Season 1
programme.desc: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map and prevent global warming.

programme.title: Evolution Earth Season 1
programme.desc: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

programme.title: Planet Shark Season 1
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its preys heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: Planet Shark Season 1
programme.desc: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: Planet Shark Season 1
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 追分成功Define Your Own Success
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. programme.desc: Anna Lisa, seorang suri rumah, menyiasat kematian misteri jirannya melalui podcast jenayah bersama dua wanita lain. Dalam mencari kebenaran, dia berdepan ugutan, pengkhianatan dan kehilangan, namun akhirnya menemui semula tujuan hidupnya.

programme.title: Black S1 EP3
programme.desc: Black mula seronok berada dalam badan manusianya. Namun menghuni tubuh badan manusia ialah jenayah Kelas A dalam dunia Bunian - Black menerima kata dua - dia mesti dapat mencari 419 atau menerima hukuman yang paling menggerunkan. Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: The Midwich Cuckoos EP3
programme.desc: Kelahiran bayi-bayi luar biasa mencetuskan kebimbangan. Tingkah laku mereka mula menunjukkan sesuatu yang tidak normal.

programme.title: Gateway

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP9
programme.desc: Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton masih tidak berpuas hati dengan Cikgu Siti yang dikatakan memiliki ilmu hitam. Perkara ini dihebohkan menyebabkan orang kampung mulai menjauhkan diri dari Cikgu Siti. Farhan menegur perbuatan Cikgu Zaiton kerana membuat fitnah kepada Cikgu Siti. Farhan masih cuba berbaik-baik dengan Cikgu Siti, bagaimanapun Cikgu Siti cuba menjauhkan diri dari Farhan kerana telah diberi amaran oleh Mak Timah.

programme.title: The Equalizer S1 EP3
programme.desc: McCall berusaha membantu seorang banduan yang melarikan diri setelah dituduh membunuh secara salah, tetapi dia terlalu tidak percaya kepada sistem keadilan yang telah mengecewakannya untuk menerima bantuan McCall. Selain itu, McCall mula risau apabila anak perempuannya, Delilah, berhenti bergaul dengan seorang rakan karibnya, manakala pencarian Detektif Dante terhadap McCall mengambil satu arah yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.

programme.title: Black S1 EP2
programme.desc: Pegawai penguatkuasa undang-undang Bunian 444 atau juga dikenali sebagai Black sedang diburu kerana rakan setugasnya seorang penderhaka, 419, telah melarikan diri ke dunia manusia. Menyedari 419 telah menghuni tubuh manusia, Black memutuskan untuk memasuki tubuh Malik untuk bersaing dengannya. Pada mata manusia, Malik telah terselamat daripada kematian dengan menakjubkan sekali dan akibat kejadian itu dia telah hilang ingatan. Dalam pada itu, Sofia mula menyedari yang Malik merupakan buat hatinya semasa kecil dan dia diselubungi rasa bersalah kerana telah meletak Malik dalam situasi bahaya. Namun Malik sekarang ialah Black - biadab, mementingkan diri sendiri dan tekad dengan satu tujuan dalam misinya. Adakah dia akan ingat siapa Sofia sebenarnya? Black mendapati dirinya berdepan dengan pembunuhan yang mengerikan semasa dia cuba mengharungi dunia manusia. Keadaan menjadi lebih rumit apabila seorang lelaki yang penuh misteri muncul dan membayangi setiap gerak-gerinya.

programme.title: Spirit Whisker: The Revenant
programme.desc: Seorang anak sulung keluarga kaya yang telah meninggal dunia tiba-tiba hidup semula selepas seekor kucing hitam misteri melompat ke atas mayatnya, yang membawa kepada kelakuannya yang pelik dan ganas yang menyebabkan keluarga itu huru-hara dan menimbulkan rahsia gelap di kalangan mereka.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang lelaki yang membela hantu raya yang di warisi oleh ayahnya dengan terpaksa. Namun lama kelamaan dia mula suka dengan saka belaan tersebut. Setelah bertahun-tahun dan usianya yang menghampiri kematian, pak Harun mula sedar dan cuba membuang hantu raya tersebut yang mula menganggu penduduk kampung. programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! programme.title: Want To De-stress

Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.desc: Journalist with an infallible nose for a story is leading the audience to explore the world. Exploring how people from different cultures overcome the challenges with collective wisdom.

programme.title: Mr.Player
programme.desc: Depending on the locations of the missions, Jacky Wu, the leader of the home team, invites various celebrities to take on challenges and bring you excitement every week.

programme.title: Flavor of Life
programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her familys beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings together.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: A school bus accident kills almost everyone on board. The bus driver got injured and partially lost his memory while rescuing one of the boys. To thank the driver, the boys dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wangs which seem to be related to the accident.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wifes betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: Victims
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victims mother and the murderers mother as they uncover their sons hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owners deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive?

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must fight to prove herself in the afterlife, where spirits are required to deliver spectacular scares to earn their place. Facing the threat of vanishing if she fails to secure a haunting license, she teams up with a washed-up ghost diva and her spectral agent, who train her to become the next star and stage the worlds greatest fright.

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a death scene investigation where the deceased body had laid undiscovered for eight years. A prosecutor joins the investigation after Choi has identified the suspect, and finds Chois actions suspicious when all manner of inconsistencies come to light from his statement...

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Brotherhood Of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his childhood friend Meow flee Hong Kong after discovering that Meow attempted to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, Chai becomes a key member of the triad. When he runs into Meow one day, he knows that his gang will kill Meow if they find him. Caught between triad and brotherhood, what will Chai choose?

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husbands mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three bizarre tales intertwine in this horror satire set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, where soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead!

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: On the final day of a shocking murder trial in Hong Kong, a renowned hypnotherapist serving as a juror receives a video showing his daughter being kidnapped. The abductors demand that he hypnotize the jury to manipulate the final verdict. Torn between justice and family, he must decide how far he is willing to go to save her.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Thunder
programme.desc: Two half-brothers, Nam and Fire, are top racing drivers. In a racing challenge with Japanese driver Kenji, Nam causes a young racing driver to be seriously injured and is depressed. Fire stands up for Nam and decides to compete with Kenji in an illegal street car race. Who will win the race? Can Nam finally bounce back?

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect partners, Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: Several down-and-out individuals find a spark in esports. From a cybercaf to the competitive arena, they form team Happy Hour, battling rivals and lifes setbacks to reclaim a second chance.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hons pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: V
programme.desc: When aliens land on Earth claiming to help humanity, they seem friendly at first. But as they integrate into society, their hidden agenda starts to unfold.

programme.title: Maamanithan
programme.desc: A humble auto driver, desperate to improve the standard of education for his children, convinces a real estate agent that he will help him sell all his plots.

programme.title: Sethupathi
programme.desc: Sethupathi, a tough police officer, investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of Vathiyar, an influential man in Madurai, but put his life, career and family at risk.

programme.title: Brother
programme.desc: A young man struggles to find his place after moving in with his sister and her in-laws.

programme.title: Ace
programme.desc: Kannan moves to a foreign country seeking life, but gets dragged into shark circle. A heist turns hope into a curse, forcing him to outsmart fate.

programme.title: Pyaar Prema Kadhal
programme.desc: Sree Kumar, a young man, falls in love with Sindhuja, a vivacious woman. However, complications soon arise and they part their separate ways only to reunite again.

programme.title: Shivanagam
programme.desc: Naganikas family is in charge of an ancient monument that Kapali has his eyes set on. When Kapali kills her to seek the monument, Naganika is reborn as a snake in her next life to seek revenge.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snares indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Rooted
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: Rooted
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

programme.title: Rooted

臺灣京崑劇團-羅生門
programme.desc: 改編自日本作家芥川龍之介的經典短篇小說竹藪中，是一部結合傳統四功五法與現代劇場思維的實驗創新大戲

programme.title: 繪自然
programme.desc: 繪自然是指國立臺灣博物館推出的繪自然－博物畫裡的臺灣特展與同名專書，主要介紹科學繪圖在臺灣的發展演進及其與自然史探索的關係

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流人間新聞此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任人間新聞報導的焦點包含慈善公益社會關懷文化藝術人文教育心靈提升健康醫療環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌

programme.title: 2025未來與希望系列講座
programme.desc: 2025未來與希望系列講座

programme.title: 體壇名人簿
programme.desc: 聚焦於運動員教練及體壇重要推手生命故事的訪談節目，透過深入對談記錄他們在競技場上的奮鬥歷程挫折與轉折

programme.title: 九局之外
programme.desc: 以棒球場外人生故事為核心的運動娛樂訪談節目，傳達在九局終局之後，才是真實人生的開場之理念，帶領觀眾深入球員與球團的內心世界

programme.title: 人生調色盤
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目人生調色盤 人生問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌憂鬱症親人失智長照等，都是過去所罕見的 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將忠孝節義的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃亞蘭話俗語單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生

programme.title: 梵音清流
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞梵唄就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義

programme.title: 尚和歌仔戲-禁忌的野菠蘿
programme.desc: 神秘的鬼影為何樹林裡夜夜徘徊？傳說中的野菠蘿，訴說著悲慘的感人故事永劫輪迴的懸疑，隱藏多少不為人知的禁忌？禁忌的野菠蘿顛覆你我的想像黑盒子劇場等你來驚艷！

programme.title: 體壇菁典E啟動

programme.title: 大愛真健康第749集

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第203集
programme.desc: 什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間在手術室在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？ 志為人醫守護愛帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親 以病為師的堅持病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人

programme.title: 行動現場第562集
programme.desc: 愛，不漏接，做，就對了！ 臺灣社會貧富懸殊強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規人力經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落 我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接需要幫助的人

programme.title: 銀髮白之歌-回音第1集
programme.desc: 1967年，花蓮深夜火警，德利豆腐店老闆娘玉鳳不顧安危，連夜帶著棉被與乾糧趕赴現場，救助災戶阿勇一家她是慈濟功德會的一員，跟隨師父的腳步，募款濟貧行善她鼓勵市場婦人每天存下五角銀，加入行善行列，奔走於各個貧戶之間，即便丈夫頗有微詞，玉鳳仍堅持走對的路 2003年的花蓮，培訓志工方金香同樣因做志工而遭母親叨念不已在培訓過程中，金香接觸到許多珍貴的歷史照片與記錄，逐漸感受到那個年代女

programme.title: 微塵見剎第1集
programme.desc: 銀髮白之歌拍攝，啟動了精舍復刻計畫， 一群人重建半世紀前那座載著慈悲初心的靜思精舍，紀實為基礎，融入藝術手法，將片中的慈濟與職人精神，透過自然且詩意的方式呈現

programme.title: 大愛真健康第749集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三五分鐘時間，跟著大愛真健康做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 映照人生第519集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大由印尼大愛臺製作的映照人生，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明

programme.title: 草根菩提第3949集
programme.desc: 有一群人用他們的生活響應 證嚴上人用鼓掌雙手做環保的理念；在他們身上，環保居然可以和生活這麼地貼近，而不是遙不可及的觀念數字或儀器這是一群很特別的人，他們無時無刻都在想著如何讓我們所住的地球更美好

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第193集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題 解讀近代事件中，慈濟曾經參與的足跡，至今正在持續的行動，以及留給未來的影響力為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展推動拔苦予樂的希望工程

programme.title: 我們的島第1374集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續1998年11月1日我們的島節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，我們的島為環境發出另一種聲音，至今我們的島仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以環境為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年我們的島製作

programme.title: 二重奏第1集

programme.title: 戀戀木瓜香第1集
programme.desc: 阮蓮香在越南與台灣彭文正邂逅，進而遠嫁來台彭文正的老媽媽廚藝精湛，卻對兒子的異國姻緣心懷疑慮頗有微詞一個家庭內有兩種文化，於是技藝超群的婆婆加上語言不通卻天資聰穎的越南媳婦，以及夾在中間的丈夫，只好透過唯一共通的語言－－美食來維繫彼此間的美味關係

programme.title: 行走TIT第420集

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第20季:第20集
programme.desc: 德魯普里察是個現代的尋寶人面對挑剔的客戶和高流通率，擁有英國最大的裝飾藝品回收場，德魯經常前往英國各地尋找被人遺棄的珍寶和古物德魯喜歡尋寶的刺激，他在缺乏建築美學的地方大肆搜刮，再帶回店裡請他的菁英修復團隊為這些古老珍寶賦予新生

programme.title: 追謎探險隊第7季:第20集
programme.desc: 本集主持人前往義大利中部探索失落數千年的伊特魯里亞文明他們是早於羅馬的先進古文明，其下水道系統道路格鬥比賽甚至服飾等元素，都被日後征服他們的羅馬融入自己的帝國之中，成為羅馬引以為傲的文明標誌

programme.title: 層層透視古文明第5季:第17集
programme.desc: 本集節目帶領觀眾認識傳奇色彩濃厚的廷塔哲城堡這裡是傳說中亞瑟王的誕生地，更是固若金湯的要塞亞瑟王的傳說深植人心，也多次被改編為文學與影視作品，但這位傳奇君王有可能真實存在嗎？廷塔哲遺跡與附近地區的其他遺構能透露什麼線索呢？斯塔福德郡出土了豐富的大批遺物，均為武器相關物品，每一件都做工精良，各具特色，看得出物主地位崇高，物主有沒有可能就是亞瑟王？敬請鎖定本節目

programme.desc: 派克一行人來到巴西塞拉佩拉達，想解開克羅索坑道之謎

programme.title: 絕地伐木勇士第2季:第14集
programme.desc: 自古以來，伐木一直是人類生活的重要產業，時至今日，仍是世界上最危險的工作之一樹越大，風險越高...報酬也越可觀在太平洋西北地區，伐木工傑瑞德道格拉斯帶著團隊，採伐世界上最巨大最有價值的樹種之一：北美檜木但要把這些體積跟巴士一樣大的巨木，從森林運送到市場一點也不容易不僅需要高超的鋸木功夫規模龐大的機械設備，還要有在地表最嚴酷環境上工的勇氣

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第13季:第11集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，介紹了食用蝸牛叉子和小輕艇的製作野外捕獲的蝸牛，要送入加工廠，經清洗去殼去腸煮熟和冷凍後，便能裝箱送出叉子的原料不鏽鋼，是將鉻鐵與鋼經處理後結合的成品；原料送至加工廠後，由模具壓出叉齒，再扳成彎曲的形狀，拋光後便完成本集介紹的小輕艇是專為釣魚而設計，具備特殊的動力鰭板，模仿水中動物的動作，裝在聚乙烯打造的船身中央，可自行在水中前進而不需划動

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第13季:第12集
programme.desc: 本集首先介紹能在戰區迅速搭建的乾式支援橋這種組合式的橋梁必須輕量又堅固，易於運輸，又能支撐坦克等重型車輛接著是油性麥克筆及螢光筆，除了看筆的各部位如何組成完整的筆，也看神奇發光墨水的製作過程最後是電動超級摩托車，透過簡化及輕量化，製造出世界上速度最快的機車

programme.title: 日用品傳奇第1季:第11集
programme.desc: 傳承與創新擦出火花，眾所周知的日用品從何而來？象徵美國西部的牛仔帽在百餘年後依舊堅持使用傳統技法做出一頂頂牛仔帽，維持品質與創新一塊加上輪子的板子成為街頭運動，創造歷史傳奇滑板手東尼霍克使用的滑板又有什麼特點讓他創造佳績？威化餅那懷舊的滋味到底是如何製成？至今仍備受喜愛的祕訣又是什麼？日用品歷久不衰的秘密在本集一一揭曉

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第4季:第9集

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第4季:第10集
programme.desc: 艾倫海夫和湯瓊斯大老遠前往東岸費城，因為當地有一間古董店結束營業，而倉儲單位因為找不到古董店倉庫的主人，所以決定拍賣對方的7間倉庫這是千載難逢的好機會，正當艾倫和湯興致高昂磨刀霍霍要競標時，他們發現一位表情嚴肅衣著講究的男子，正拿著清單盤點倉庫的內容物顯然對方和古董店公司有關係，並掌握了倉庫內的物品清單，這使得他握有競標的絕對優勢加上這位神秘男子在出價時毫不手軟，使艾倫和湯兩人幾乎束手無策，眼看著這趟代價高昂的行程將付之流水
